title: PC-CROP Federal Accounting — honest manual integration fallback
purpose: Implement the provider-independent manual fallback from section 62 so blocked/unavailable external integrations still have an honest export/import path without manufacturing SENT, PROVIDER_CONFIRMED or POSTED states.
boundaries: Allowed artifact formats are exactly XML, PDF, CSV, XLSX, CANONICAL_JSON and EVIDENCE_ZIP.
Exporting a file never implies it was sent.
Human/manual evidence never becomes provider-confirmed evidence.
A document created in 1C never becomes POSTED by implication.
No provider credential, API call, runtime route, browser upload, storage write, Prisma, auth, banking, FGIS, hosting or production mutation.
Merge and green CI are not production acceptance.
requiredChecks: existing PC-CROP accounting and security gates
